Company:
TITAN Haptics

Role:
Mechatronics Integration Engineer

Core work:
- Architect and build end-to-end hardware prototypes.
- Develop PCB layouts, mechanical assemblies, and enclosure mockups.
- Select sensors, microcontrollers, connectors, and 3D-printed parts.
- Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software teams.
- Integrate drivers, test real hardware, and iterate performance.
- Support customer design-in projects.
- Define requirements and troubleshoot integration issues.
- Create reference code and integration examples.
- Design electrical, waveform, durability, and reliability tests.
- Perform root-cause investigations.
- Maintain schematics, BOMs, integration guides, and test reports.
- Translate customer feedback into design improvements.

Candidate requirements:
- Hands-on hardware prototypes.
- SolidWorks or Fusion 360.
- PCB breadboarding and circuit assembly.
- 3D printing.
- Microcontrollers including STM32.
- C/C++.
- Mechanical, electrical, and firmware integration.
- Engineering documentation.
- Git.
- Lab and prototyping tools.
- Electronics, robotics, or IoT side projects.

Culture, benefits, and compensation:
- Collaborative multidisciplinary team.
- Competitive benefits and compensation.
- General personality and culture language.
